derived.claim: F2 and F31 read the two port tables as disagreeing. They are really answering different questions under one word. CONDUCTOR's 'unbound' means no composition root at all. coryphaeus's 'Default (nothing bound)' means the root is present but no provider, such as the brief, is bound: validate.mjs and local_rulings exist only because coryphaeus is there. So the round has three states: no root, root only, and root plus provider. The language names two of them, and the record names none. Name the three binding levels once, in CONDUCTOR, and let coryphaeus's column cite the middle one.
